DABUR.d: Dabur India Limited manufactures and sells consumer goods, including Ayurvedic healthcare, personal care, and food products. It serves retail consumers globally through a vast distribution network.

DALBHARAT.d: Dalmia Bharat Limited manufactures and sells cement and cement products under various brand names. It serves the construction and infrastructure sectors primarily in the eastern, southern, and northern regions of India.

DATAPATTNS.d: Data Patterns India designs and manufactures defense and aerospace electronics, including radar systems and electronic warfare suites. Its primary customers are defense public sector undertakings and government agencies.

DBL.d: Dilip Buildcon Limited constructs roads, bridges, irrigation systems, and urban infrastructure projects. It executes engineering, procurement, and construction contracts primarily for government agencies.

DCMSHRIRAM.d: DCM Shriram is a diversified conglomerate operating in agri-inputs, chlor-vinyl, and sugar businesses. It serves agricultural and industrial customers across India.

DEEPAKFERT.d: Deepak Fertilizers and Petrochemicals Corporation Limited manufactures industrial chemicals, agricultural fertilizers, and crop nutrients. Its products serve mining, chemical, and farming sectors.

DEEPAKNTR.d: Deepak Nitrite Limited manufactures basic chemicals, fine chemicals, specialty chemicals, and performance products used in agrochemicals, dyes, and pharmaceuticals. It serves industrial customers globally.

DELHIVERY.d: Delhivery Limited provides supply chain and logistics services, including express parcel delivery, freight services, and warehousing. It serves e-commerce businesses, enterprises, and SMEs across India.

DEVYANI.d: Devyani International Limited operates quick-service and casual dining restaurants in India and internationally. It is a major franchise partner for brands such as KFC, Pizza Hut, and Costa Coffee.

DHOOTTRANS.d: Dhoot Transmission Limited manufactures automotive wiring harnesses, switches, and sensors. It supplies components directly to major two-wheeler, commercial vehicle, and passenger vehicle manufacturers.

DIACABS.d: Diamond Power Infrastructure Limited manufactures electrical cables and conductors for power transmission and distribution utilities across India. The state-owned company produces various wire products for infrastructure projects.

DIVISLAB.d: Divi's Laboratories Limited manufactures active pharmaceutical ingredients, intermediates, and nutraceutical ingredients. It supplies global pharmaceutical companies and operates as a major custom synthesis player.

DIXON.d: The company provides electronic manufacturing services for consumer electronics, lighting, mobile phones, and home appliances to various global and domestic brands.

DLF.d: DLF Limited develops residential, commercial, and retail real estate properties primarily in India. It is the country's largest publicly listed real estate company by market capitalization.

DMART.d: Avenue Supermarts Limited owns and operates the DMart chain of retail supermarkets across India. It sells a wide range of food, grocery, and apparel products directly to consumers.

DODLA.d: Dodla Dairy Limited processes and sells milk and value-added dairy products like curd, butter, and ghee. Its main customers are retail consumers and institutional buyers in southern India.

DOMS.d: DOMS Industries Limited manufactures and sells a wide range of stationery and art products, including pencils, pens, and mathematical instruments. Its primary end markets are students and educational institutions globally.

DRREDDY.d: Dr. Reddy's Laboratories manufactures and markets generic pharmaceuticals, active pharmaceutical ingredients, and biosimilars globally. Its customers include hospitals, pharmacies, and healthcare providers.

DYNAMATECH.d: Dynamatic Technologies manufactures hydraulic pumps, automotive components, and aerospace structures for global OEMs. It operates advanced engineering facilities in India, Europe, and the US.
